articles.title: Hong Kong moves to extend crypto licensing rules to brokers, advisers and custodians
articles.snippet: Hong Kong wants to bring crypto brokers, advisers, asset managers and custodians under its existing regulatory framework.

articles.title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid and other onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to U.S. traders if they obtain the required licenses or work with a registered exchange, the CFTC chairman said.

articles.title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
articles.snippet: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.

articles.title: Binance’s $6.5B freeze order, Hong Kong ‘suspicious’ of HYPE: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Binance obtains court orders freezing assets stolen in October’s hack. Hong Kong warns citizens about Hyperliquid, and Thai police arrest four foreigners linked to a crypto scam.

articles.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
articles.snippet: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.
